Circular on state service contracts considered
se: The meeting considered the effects of service contracts of state agencies whose work does not accord with the Public Procurement and Supplies Administration Act B.E. 2560 (2017), together with the most urgent circular of the Comptroller General's Department No. Kor Kor (Kor Wor Jor) 0405.2/Wor 727 of 22 September 2026, clarifying the understanding of service contracts (natural persons)
it: The effects of service contracts of state agencies whose work does not accord with the Public Procurement and Supplies Administration Act B.E. 2560 (2017)

te: Meeting summary video · Circular on state service contracts considered
Summary of the study visit on the draft labour protection laws
se: The meeting summarised the study visit to Suphan Buri and Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Provinces on 25–26 September 2026, which heard the views of employers and employees on 3 draft Labour Protection Acts
it: Summary of the study visit to Suphan Buri and Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya Provinces (25–26 September 2026)

te: Meeting summary video · Summary of the study visit on the draft labour protection laws
Letters giving views on labour conventions considered
se: The meeting considered letters sent in giving views on the proposal to sign international labour conventions, and on the period of validity of status documents for children of foreign workers born in Thailand
it: Letters giving views on the proposal on international labour conventions

te: Work in 2026 summarised, and plans for 2027 made
se: The meeting considered the summary of its work for fiscal year 2026 and its work plan for fiscal year 2027, including urgent issues on labour rights in the new era
it: Summary of work for fiscal year 2026 and work plan for fiscal year 2027

te: Summary of the seminar on independent and platform workers
se: The meeting summarised the seminar held on 18 August 2026, attended by about 350 people, and gathered the views given for use in its study report
it: Summary of the seminar on the problems and future of protecting independent workers and platform workers

se: The meeting prepared the seminar on the problems and future of protecting independent workers and platform workers, aiming for 300 participants, including seats for labour groups, with online registration and a live broadcast so that the public can follow it
it: Holding the seminar on the problems and future of protecting independent workers and platform workers

te: Petition on wages in the security guard business considered
se: The meeting considered a petition proposing ways to solve problems of employment under the minimum wage notification and to allocate the state budget for security guard services fairly, hearing information from business operators and the agencies concerned

te: Approach set for the seminar on independent and platform workers
se: The meeting considered its approach to holding a seminar on independent and platform workers on 18 August 2026 at Parliament House, to present its draft study report, build understanding of international labour standards and hear the views of stakeholders
